title: Reduce NOT TRUE
description: You can read negation as a selector applied to reversed Boolean alternatives.

steps.description: NOT supplies FALSE and TRUE to its Boolean argument. TRUE is the function that selects its first argument.
Beta reduction substitutes TRUE for b. The selector now receives FALSE first and TRUE second.

steps.question: Which supplied Boolean will TRUE select?
steps.answer: It selects FALSE, its first argument.

steps.description: The remaining applications reduce to FALSE. The displayed lambda result selects its second argument.
